text: This report responds to Council direction, HL23.1 in November 2020, to the Deputy City Manager, Community and Social Services, to provide a progress report to the Executive Committee in the first quarter of 2021 on the success of the TO Supports Targeted COVID-19 Equity Measures program and funding levels received from other governments to supports its delivery. Launched in late November, the targeted and enhanced equity measures focused on working with strategic partners to expand COVID-19 testing sites, intensify resident education and engagement, provide necessary wrap around supports, and advocate for those who test positive for COVID-19 and are unable to work due to mandatory isolation.
